queries.result: The official municipal site was found and its search result exposes Geoprocessamento, Mapas Urbanos, Cadastro Imobiliário and Cadastro de Projetos de Loteamento. A 2025 official municipal publication confirms the Cadastro Imobiliário Municipal procedure. No public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed by the accessible page.

queries.result: Resultados em português localizaram a Prefeitura, a referência ao sistema Geomais usado pelo setor de geoprocessamento e atos oficiais sobre atualização cadastral, além do procedimento municipal de Cadastro Imobiliário. The public municipal homepage redirected to Google during direct retrieval, so no anonymous map/API response was verified.

researchNote: A local municipal cadastral custodian and cadastral procedure are evidenced, but no public parcel geometry/API response was obtained. This packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
